claims.statement: Northgate Business Park sold on March 14, 2025 for $41,000,000, at a price of $276.10 per square foot, on a building of 148,500 square feet.

citations.quote: Northgate Business Park traded in March 2025 for $41,000,000 ($276.10 per square foot)

claims.statement: The retrieved evidence gives two conflicting cap rate figures for Northgate Business Park: the underwriting memo states a cap rate of approximately 6.10%, while the comps workbook records a cap rate of 5.25% for the same transaction.
